description: A full Minesweeper game — three difficulties, real mine placement, flood-fill reveals, flagging, and win/lose detection.

faqs.a: Beginner (9×9, 10 mines), Intermediate (16×16, 40 mines) and Expert (16×30, 99 mines).
Left-click (or tap) reveals a cell; right-click (or long-press / the 🚩 toggle) places a flag.
faqs.q: How do I flag a mine?

faqs.a: Yes — the first cell you reveal is always safe, along with its neighbors.
faqs.q: Is the first click always safe?

faqs.a: You win by revealing every non-mine cell. Flagging all mines is not required.

howto: Pick a difficulty and press New game.
Click cells to reveal — numbers show adjacent mines.
Right-click (or toggle 🚩 mode) to flag suspected mines.
Reveal every safe cell to win. Avoid the 💣!
title: Minesweeper Game
